basic_details.job_title: TISS Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) has announced 2 vacancies for Teaching Assistant (Full Time) and Teaching Assistant (Part Time) posts on a contract basis for a duration of 09 months from 1 November 2026 to 31 July 2027 at the Mumbai Campus. Applicants must be a Post Graduate in Clinical/ Counselling Psychology with relevant experience. The notified pay is Rs. 60,000 pm for the Full Time post and Rs. 45,000 pm for the Part Time post under advertisement number TISS/SHE/STP/PGD-TFT/1/26-27. Candidates must apply online by providing a Gmail ID and take a print of the acknowledgment, with

how_to_apply: Visit the Institute's website at www.tiss.ac.in and access the online application link provided along with the advertisement.
Fill out the online application form ensuring you provide your Gmail ID.
Submit the online application on or before the last date, which is 23 October 2026.
Take a printout of the acknowledgment of the online application and keep it safely for future reference.
important_instructions: The position is unreserved, but candidates belonging to reserved categories can apply. The Institute reserves the right to relax any of the qualification, experience, or age limit in exceptional cases, or for persons holding analogous positions in Government Departments, Research and Academic Institutions, or Industry. Merely possessing the prescribed qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview due to potential shortlisting. Candidates under employment must produce a 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer to appear for the interview. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will lead to debarment from consideration. The selected candidate must join within 15 days of selection.

rows.details: Teaching Assistant (Full Time), Teaching Assistant (Part Time)
Rs. 60,000/- pm (Full Time), Rs. 45,000/- pm (Part Time)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The School of Human Ecology at TISS Mumbai is recruiting for two positions under the Postgraduate Diploma in Trauma-Focused Therapy program. *[based on course timings which includes weekday evenings 05:45 - 08:15 pm and weekday afternoons 02:00 – 05:00 pm, 3 days a week]

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the essential qualification requirements prescribed by the institute to be eligible for consideration. Essential Qualification: Post Graduate in Clinical/ Counselling Psychology with relevant experience in clinical practice and/or teaching. Preferred Qualifications: Candidates with M.Phil and having completed a foundational training in trauma-informed psychotherapy will be preferred. Conversant with MS PowerPoint and ability to create collaterals like flyers, posters etc using softwares like Canva. Good communication skills in English and Hindi. Ability to work in a team with quick turnaround time.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are offered for a fixed duration of 09 months, starting from 1 November 2026 and concluding on 31 July 2027. The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 60,000/- per month for the Full-Time Teaching Assistant and Rs. 45,000/- per month for the Part-Time Teaching Assistant. The selected candidate would be required to join within 15 days of selection.

content_sections.heading: TISS Teaching Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Teaching Assistant will assist the Faculty-in-Charge for the STP with the following responsibilities: Collate and curate teaching materials and learning aids. Assist in evaluation and documentation aspects of the program. Coordinating with students in the courses regarding classes, tasks, and deadlines. Generating creative content regarding the course, such as announcements, events, posters, etc., and circulation on Social Media via TISS’ authorized channels. Liaising with organizations regarding fieldwork. Coordination with staff and faculty in the course. Assist in documentation of ongoing research. Note: The Teaching Assistant will not be required to conduct classes by themselves.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be shortlisted based on the prescribed qualifications and requisite experience. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email regarding the date, time, and mode (online/offline) of the Personal Interaction to be conducted by TISS, Mumbai. Candidates attending the personal interaction must bring self-attested photocopies of their educational qualification certificates, work experience certificates, and valid ID proof, along with original documents for verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Teaching Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, divided into 1 Full-Time and 1 Part-Time position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of the online application is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Clinical or Counselling Psychology with relevant experience in clinical practice and/or teaching.

faq.question: Q4. What salary is offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 60,000/- per month for the Full-Time Teaching Assistant and Rs. 45,000/- per month for the Part-Time Teaching Assistant.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for applying?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can eligible candidates apply for the position?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the link provided on the TISS official website at www.tiss.ac.in using their Gmail ID.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interaction conducted by TISS, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q8. Are teaching assistants required to conduct classes independently?
faq.answer: No, teaching assistants will not be required to conduct classes by themselves; their role involves assisting the Faculty-in-Charge.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the engagement?
faq.answer: The contract duration is 09 months, spanning from 1 November 2026 to 31 July 2027.
